He is dressed in a light beige, long-sleeved sweatshirt. His hands are positioned over the white and black keys, intermittently pressing them while he speaks directly to the camera with a neutral but engaged expression. The background is a dimly lit indoor room, possibly a bedroom or home studio, decorated with warm, out-of-focus fairy lights on a wall behind him. To his right, a black professional microphone on a red boom arm is visible. (2) The man begins singing and playing a rhythmic piano melody. A semi-transparent square inset appears on the right side of the screen, showing a scene from a music video featuring a girl with short hair in a snowy forest. Another inset on the left displays the album art of Stella Huang. The man's facial expressions become more emotive, reflecting the song's sentiment, while his fingers move fluidly across the keyboard. Yellow text captions appear at the bottom center of the frame. (3) The visual layout remains similar but the content of the insets changes as the song transitions. The right-hand inset now displays scenes of a woman with long hair wearing a scarf on a sandy beach at dusk. The man continues to sing, his eyes occasionally closing for emphasis. The lighting remains warm and consistent, with the fairy lights providing a soft bokeh effect in the background. (4) A brief close-up of the man's hands on the piano keys highlights his playing technique during a short instrumental bridge. The scene then returns to the medium shot as he starts a new song. The insets now feature Evonne Hsu, showing a woman in a black coat standing in a snowy field and interacting with snowmen. Captions continue to sync with his vocal performance. (5) The man finishes singing and looks back at the camera. Three icons representing the album covers of the three singers discussed are superimposed over the center of the screen in a vertical arrangement. He stops playing the piano, and his hands rest on the keys. The warm lighting and the background studio elements remain unchanged as the video concludes.
